questions.prompt: A pot rake or drop makes marginal calls worse because…

choices.text: You win less than the chips in the middle. The price you were getting shrinks.
It adds chips to the pot

questions.explanation: This trainer does not deduct rake yet. Live, the house takes a piece before you are paid.

questions.prompt: Small pots are punished more by a percent rake or a drop than large pots because…

choices.text: The rake is a bigger fraction of a small pot, up to the cap.
Large pots are raked at a higher percent forever
Rake is a flat fee equal to the pot

questions.explanation: Stealing a tiny pot can be a loss after the drop. Winning a capped pot gives the rake back as a smaller percent.

questions.prompt: Time rake, common at some $5/$10 and higher games, is…

choices.text: A seat charge for time, not a percent of each pot. This app does not charge it.
A card that is dealt twice
The same as a pot drop

questions.explanation: Time collection does not shrink each pot, so speculative hands are less taxed than under a drop. The lineup is usually tougher.

choices.text: Money you choose to give the dealer. It is not won back from the pot.
Added to your stack by the casino
A required part of every call

questions.explanation: Tipping is a cost of the session. It is not a strategy bet.
